summary: Iteration 150 - P0 Features (City Ledger, Tax Config, Deposit Policies) Testing Complete. Backend: 30/30 tests passed. Frontend: All 3 panels render correctly with all UI elements. Fixed missing imports in App.js and syntax error in city_ledger.py.

tests: POST /api/city-ledger/companies creates company with id, open_balance enrichment
GET /api/city-ledger/companies returns list with open_balance/open_invoices enriched

DELETE /api/city-ledger/companies/{id} blocks deletion when open invoices exist (400)
POST /api/tax-config/calculate respects included_in_rate flag (taxes_included vs taxes_added)

POST /api/deposit-policies/evaluate matches policies in priority order

POST /api/deposit-policies/evaluate correctly calculates deposit_required for flat type

critical_code_review_comments: All 3 P0 features are fully functional end-to-end
City Ledger correctly enriches companies with open_balance/open_invoices from invoices collection
Invoice auto-numbering uses CL-YYYY-NNNNN format with sequential counter per year
